interstitial_enabled.description: Interstitial between hunts at all (false = only voluntary rewarded ads).

interstitial_min_sessions.description: First interstitial only after this many hunts in total (0-1000).

interstitial_min_interval_s.description: Seconds since any ad, rewarded too, before an interstitial (0-86400).

offers_enabled.description: The menu pitches paid offers after hunts (false = the store still sells, no popups).

starter_offer_after_hunts.description: Rookie kit (starter_pack) offered from this many hunts (0-1000).

premium_offer_after_hunts.description: Full version offered after an ad break from this many hunts (0-1000).

witching_hour_start.description: Local hour the witching hour starts (0-23). In-game texts say 23:00.

witching_hour_end.description: Local hour the witching hour ends (0-23).

min_version_code.description: Builds with a lower versionCode see the 'update' card in the menu (0 = nobody).

season_event.description: Seasonal event in force (halloween): the jack-o-lantern ghost, the candy in the room and the skin shelf run while it says halloween (and until halloween_end). Empty = no event.

progressive_ui.description: The menu opens up as the agent plays (false = the whole menu from the first launch). Old saves always see everything.

unlock_ectoplasm_hunts.description: Hunts before the ectoplasm balance shows (0-1000).

unlock_ration_hunts.description: Hunts before the daily ration icon and its card (0-1000).

unlock_shop_hunts.description: Hunts before the SHOP and the loadout row (0-1000).

notify_prompt_after_hunts.description: Hunts (any result) before the notifications card and the Settings switch (0-1000).

briefing_starts_hunt.description: The last page of the first briefing starts the first hunt (false = it just closes).

first_hunt_virtual.description: The very first hunt goes to the Virtual Room, no camera dialog (true = skip the camera for hunt 1).

ab_1.description: A/B slot 1: "<test id>:<variant>", set by the studio console; mirrored to the GA4 user property ab_1.

ab_2.description: A/B slot 2: "<test id>:<variant>", set by the studio console; mirrored to the GA4 user property ab_2.

ab_3.description: A/B slot 3: "<test id>:<variant>", set by the studio console; mirrored to the GA4 user property ab_3.

halloween_jack_percent.description: Chance, in percent, that a hunt (after the two taught ones) is against the Jack-o-Lantern while the Halloween event runs (0-100).

halloween_candy_per_hunt.description: How many candies lie around a hunt (0-10). Empty = the game default (3-5 at random).

halloween_end.description: Last day of the Halloween event, yyyy-MM-dd. Empty = the game default (2026-11-02); candy burns the day after.

halloween_price_beam_pumpkin.description: Candy price of the Pumpkin Beam skin (0-1000).

halloween_price_lens_cobweb.description: Candy price of the Cobweb Lens Frame skin (0-1000).

halloween_price_radar_jack.description: Candy price of the Jack Radar skin (0-1000).

rookie_fade_captures.description: Catches over which the rookie help fades to nothing (1-1000). Build 1.0.6+.

rookie_capture_rate.description: Beam charge multiplier for a rookie with no catches (0.1-5), fading with catches. Build 1.0.6+.

rookie_ghost_speed.description: Ghost speed multiplier for a rookie with no catches (0.1-5). Build 1.0.6+.

rookie_beamed_speed.description: Extra speed multiplier of a ghost under the beam for a rookie (0.05-5; 0.35 = it barely moves while held). Build 1.0.6+.

rookie_leash_m.description: While beamed, a rookie ghost never gets farther than this from the camera, in metres (0 = off, max 10). Build 1.0.6+.

rookie_leash_captures.description: Catches the leash lasts for (0 = never). Build 1.0.6+.

rookie_free_charge_hunts.description: First hunts whose dead battery gets one free recharge on the emergency card (0 = off). Build 1.0.6+.

rookie_free_charge.description: Share of the battery the free recharge restores (0-1). Build 1.0.6+.

review_min_captures.description: Catches before the Play review dialog is asked for (1-1000). Build 1.0.6+.

review_min_photo_stars.description: A kept photo with this many stars asks for the review before any catch (0 = off, 1-3). Build 1.0.6+.

halloween_welcome_candy.description: Candy every player gets once while the Halloween event runs (0-100). Build 1.0.6+.

halloween_jack_from_hunt.description: First hunt (1-based, from 2) the Jack-o-Lantern may come to. Build 1.0.6+.

rookie_leash_growth_m.description: Metres the leash grows with every catch (0-10), so the help fades gradually. Build 1.0.6+.

beamed_flee_scale.description: Speed multiplier of every ghost under the beam, before lasers and rookie help (0.05-1; 1 = full flee speed). Build 1.0.6+.
